behavior: Retains every outgoing enemy wreck, paired authoritative event history, and each candidate identity victim/frame in an append-only deduplicated ledger.

Selects first eligible candidate once; stops after the same2200ms return window or existing180s/race-finish limit. An eligible candidate with failed quality gates is never replaced by a later candidate.

Passes selected victim/frame into analysis and brackets cue birth against that event so a later kill cue cannot substitute. Existing pace, camera-baseline and retained-view gate block is byte-identical.
Keeps new-directory-only output creation and refuses a frozen bundle missing the read-only controller diagnostic. No eligible candidate remains FAIL/uncovered.
